Counsel for Respondent :- Bhupeshwar Dayal,C.S.C.,Shiv Prakash Gupta
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Ramesh Kumar Singh holding brief of Sri Bhupeshwar Dayal, learned counsel appearing on behalf of respondent no. 3.
3.

The petitioner has challenged the order dated 27.12.2021 passed by Collector, Meerut deciding the representation of the petitioner for release of compensation amount for the land acquired under the Smt. Sudarshan Juneja vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 9 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109648509/
1 provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

entities.text: Smt. Sudarshan Juneja vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been held that a civil suit filed by the petitioner bearing no. 1275 of 1995 was dismissed in default on 12.10.2010.
Thereafter, the petitioner filed restoration application and it was registered as Misc. Case No. 92 of 2010.
It was allowed by order dated 14.09.2012 and suit was restored to its original number.
The decision relating to payment of compensation would be taken after the civil suit is decided.
4. A supplementary affidavit has been filed by the petitioner stating that the petitioner has withdrawn the suit.
Copy of the order dated 11.05.2022 by which the application for withdrawal of suit was allowed and the suit was dismissed has been filed alongwith the supplementary affidavit.

5. Counsel for the petitioner submits that since suit has been withdrawn by the petitioner and,
therefore, the petitioner in terms of the impugned order will approach the Authority once again for taking decision in respect of his claim for release of the compensation amount.
6. Accordingly, the instant petition is disposed of with the aforesaid liberty to the petitioner.
7. In case the petitioner files any such application, the same shall be decided by the concerned respondent in accordance with law within a period of eight weeks.
(Kshitij Shailendra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 9.4.2024
Ruhi H.
